user.description: Use the password on the modem's label, or your own if you changed it.

reauth_confirm.description: The modem rejected the saved password. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: The modem rejected the password. It locks the login after 5 bad attempts.
error.session_busy: Someone else is logged in to the modem. Log out of its web page and try again.
error.login_locked: The modem login is locked after too many bad passwords. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected reply from the modem. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This modem is already set up.

reboot.name: Reboot modem
reboot.description: Reboots the modem. The internet drops for a minute or two.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Use the Wi-Fi address your network sees. Phones and tablets often use a private address for each network.

remove_device.title: Remove a device
remove_device.description: Removing a device also takes it off the modem's block list, which restarts the Wi-Fi if it was listed.

error.already_added: This device has already been added.
error.not_ready: Could not update the modem, so the device was kept. Try again shortly.
